description: HIFLD Open U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) Maritime Differential GPS (DGPS) Locations is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (U.S. Coast Guard et al.). NAVCEN operates the Coast Guard Maritime Differential GPS (DGPS) Service and the developing Nationwide DGPS Service (NDGPS), consisting of two control centers and 86 remote broadcast sites. The service broadcasts correction signals on marine radiobeacon frequencies to improve the accuracy and integrity of GPS-derived positions. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
